column1: # One program's rows of the -db fixtures (see README.md here for the columns and the loader in ../db_search_fixtures.py).

# Rows db.ps.* (line PS, PS1): psiblast's first round against tests/db_search/paja, the queries of tests/fasta/psiblast/ (WSSV proteins of tests/fasta/WSSV.faa and constructed records); the ncbi rows are NCBI 2.17.0 `psiblast -db ... -num_threads 1`.

# Rows db.ps.pssm.* (line PS, PS2): psiblast's ASCII PSSM (-save_pssm_after_last_round -out_ascii_pssm, round 1); the files column is pssm: the runner adds -out_ascii_pssm <tmp>/<row_id>.pssm and the files NCBI wrote are frozen as <row_id>.pssm and <row_id>.pssm.<n> (side_sha256; empty: no file). Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --only db.ps.pssm.

# Rows db.ps.asn.* (line PS, PS3): psiblast's ASN.1 PSSM (-save_pssm_after_last_round -out_pssm, round 1); the files column is pssm-asn (the runner adds -out_pssm <tmp>/<row_id>.asn) or pssm-both (and -out_ascii_pssm <tmp>/<row_id>.pssm), or pssm with an -out_pssm argument of its own; side_sha256 lists every file written as <suffix>=<SHA-256>:<bytes>, and a file is frozen as <row_id>.asn / .pssm exactly when it is 64 KB or less (a larger one is compared by its SHA-256 alone; the ASN.1 PSSM of the 398-letter tk is 441 KB, 729 KB with the diagnostics of -out_ascii_pssm). The rejection row db.ps.asn.rej.nodir.7 has NCBI's stdout of the same command (stdout_bytes set): NCBI stops after the first query's report with its serial-stream error, LOSAT at the same place with its refusal. An argument {pre:<suffix>} writes the file <tmp>/<row_id><suffix> with the bytes "previous file\n" before the run instead of being passed (db.ps.asn.pre.*: an existing file kept or replaced; the case of a report write error, which needs Linux's /dev/full, is the Rust test tests/psiblast_pssm_files.rs). Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --only db.ps.asn.

# Rows db.ps.inpssm.* (line PS, PS4a): psiblast -in_pssm (a PSSM query) against tests/db_search/paja, with -comp_based_stats 0 (or F) unless the row tests its refusal. Query cell pssm-gz:PATH: the runner inflates the gzipped PSSM PATH into a temporary directory and passes -in_pssm <that file> in place of -query; pssm:PATH passes -in_pssm PATH as it is (xinclude_fixtures.py query_argv). The PSSMs (tests/fixtures/pssm/ps4_*): NCBI 2.17.0's psiblast -num_iterations 1 -save_pssm_after_last_round -out_pssm of tests/fasta/psiblast/tk.faa and tk_xbz.faa against paja, and hand edits of the rnd PSSM (tests/fixtures/db_search/db.ps.asn.rnd.6.asn): 26 rows, a scaling factor, isProtein FALSE, no data, a column too few, a gi Seq-id, a non-ASCII title, CRLF, two PSSMs in one file, cut in half; ps4_empty.asn is empty and ps4_binary.asn holds a few BER bytes. The err.* rows are NCBI's errors; the rej.* rows LOSAT's refusals (DECISIONS 11 of line PS). Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --only db.ps.inpssm.

# Rows db.ps.inpssm.cbs.* (line PS, PS4b): psiblast -in_pssm with the position-based composition-based statistics: the default -comp_based_stats and modes 1, 3 and T (NCBI runs 2 and 3 as 1 with a PSSM, with a warning), the redo's heaps, the frequency-ratio warning, a PSSM of frequency ratios only. Inputs added (tests/fixtures/pssm/): ps4_tk_zr (the tk PSSM with every frequency ratio 0), ps4_tk_ratios (the tk PSSM without its scores: frequency ratios only), ps4_lcq_paja (NCBI's PSSM against paja of a low-complexity query, a Q run of BDT63563.1), ps4_rnd_ratios_byrow (ps4_rnd_byrow without finalData: frequency ratios only, by row; rejection). Review fixes: ps4_tk_eps (the tk PSSM with every frequency ratio 5e-5). Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --only db.ps.inpssm.cbs.

# Rows db.sc3.* (line NP, series SC, SC3): BLASTP -task blastp-short and -word_size 2 with -db: the short queries of tests/fasta/outfmt0/sc3_short_q.faa and the 89 proteins of tests/fasta/SicyWSV.faa against tests/db_search/paja, composition mode 0, the one-hit search, culling, PAM30, blastp-fast, and a query split into chunks (tests/db_search/split_q.faa against tests/seqdb/db/prot_v4). Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --only db.sc3.

# Rows db.tm.* (line DBID, item T): NCBI's messages about the taxonomy database (BLASTDB=tests/seqdb/taxdb/<variant>) in the formats that prefetch the reported subjects (outfmt 0, 5, 6, 7, 17), all five programs: the open messages (bad_magic, count_larger), the volume lookup of a taxid at the last index entry (offset_last_past_end, databases x16_*taxid_99990), several batches (BATCH_SIZE=100), a batch whose first queries have warnings of their own (x16_*qinv: letters that give no Karlin-Altschul parameters, a query without letters), a database with parsed Seq-ids, and a taxonomy database without messages (good). Review 1 (db.tm.bp.fast.*, db.tm.bp.2vol.*, db.tm.*.cache*): blastp-fast with two query blocks (tests/db_search/tm_fast_q289.faa), an alias of two volumes (tests/db_search/tm_2vol), and the volumes tm_cache150 (refused: a taxid of the slot of the offset error's taxid in NCBI's per-volume taxonomy cache) and tm_cache151 (its control); tests/db_search/README.md says how they were made. Item P1 (db.tm.psi.*, db.tm.bp.off0.*): psiblast's prefetch of its traceback hit lists (tests/db_search/tm_psi: a subject beyond -max_target_seqs 1), one query per batch, and PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT turning the prefetch off (0, or below the batch's Seq-aligns: lim6 against lim7; fields that read no subject: qe), blastp too; review 1: subjects beyond the cut whose Seq-align id is found nowhere (tm_psi_pig), fails (tm_psi_rz) or is held by another sequence (tm_psi_held: no taxid, no lookup; tm_psi_held2: taxid 99990, refused). Item P2 (db.tm.{bn,tn,bx,tx}.off0.*, db.tm.tn.lim*, db.tm.tx.lim1.*, db.tm.{bn,bx}.ug.*): PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT turning the prefetch off in BLASTN, TBLASTN, BLASTX and TBLASTX: the messages after the warnings of the query whose report fetches (x16_*qinv), none for fields that read no subject (qe; BLASTN's formatter also for nident), outfmt 5 (warnings in the Iteration messages), the volume lookup once per volume and taxid (lastoff), and the batch's Seq-aligns at the limit: one per HSP of a gapped search (tblastn lim2 against lim3), one per subject of an ungapped one (tblastx lim1, blastn and blastx -ungapped lim2); review 1: the subject's frame with a coordinate field in the translated programs (frame, sframe), and a run whose batches never prefetch and whose fields read no subject on tm_cache150 (not refused).

# Rows db.im.* (line DBID P3): PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT=2147483647, at which NCBI's s_PreFetchSeqs prefetches before it tests the format (blast_app_util.cpp:738-740), so also for the Seq-annots outfmt 8, 9 and 12 (not the archive, written without the prefetch): the taxonomy database's messages of db.tm.* after the reader's messages (BLASTN, TBLASTN, BLASTX, TBLASTX, BLASTP), the variable unset as a control, and the subjects with parsed Seq-ids that the prefetch reads by their Seq-align ids: lcl|777 before gi|777 without and with a Seq-align whose length the prefetch asks for; losat-rejection: a lookup that fails, another sequence whose definition lines do not hold the id (NCBI exit 2; also psiblast's list beyond -max_target_seqs, which NCBI prefetches at any value) and copies whose texts depend on the copy NCBI reads (as in outfmt 6).

# Rows db.oldfsc.* (line SW, env parity G1): the environment variable OLD_FSC (any value, the empty one too), with which NCBI's protein programs have no Gumbel block (blast_stat.c:921-923): the E-values and cutoffs without the finite-size correction, as with `-searchsp 0` (NCBI sets OLD_FSC for any -searchsp, blast_args.cpp:303-307) but with the archive's options of a search without -searchsp; -ungapped frees the block anyway (blast_setup.c:521-527; BLASTX, the program of these three that LOSAT searches ungapped). BLASTP, BLASTX, TBLASTN, PSIBLAST (PS5c) and RPSBLAST (PS11c-2, rows db.rps.mini.oldfsc.* in rpsblast.tsv) read it (`old_fsc`).

# Rows db.acbs.* (line SW, env parity G2+G3): the environment variable ADAPTIVE_CBS (any value, the empty one too), with which NCBI's protein programs keep a larger preliminary hit list with composition-based statistics (blast_hits.c:43-70) and, for a hit list size below 1000, cut it by E-value when the stream closes (BlastHSPCBSStreamClose, blast_hspstream.c:816-864; not PSIBLAST, whose traceback size is the preliminary size): tests/db_search/acbs and acbs_n (README.md there), the 1,050 vs 1,500 lists of 700 composition-biased and 1,000 ordinary subjects; rows near/wrap/crash: -max_target_seqs whose preliminary size passes NCBI's int (BLASTX; NCBI wraps it or crashes), which LOSAT computes without the overflow (PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS exception 19, line O1c): each is compared with NCBI's run at 1073741798, its `ncbi-near` row near.*.

# Rows db.mdb.* (DI-8f, dropin-survey-20261029/DI8): -db with several names (`-db "a b"`: one virtual database, as NCBI's CSeqDB) on the databases of tests/db_search/multidb (make_multidb.py): version 5 pairs with taxids (pa pb, na nb; nb and pb hold a copy of a sequence of the other), a version 5 database without -parse_seqids (nnp), version 4 pairs (n4a n4b, p4a p4b), one base name in two directories (d1/g d2/g), an empty title (et), an alias (al), a seqid list (sl.txt); the names given twice, in the other order, in double quotes (Galaxy) and with extra spaces; db.mdb.bn.v4v5.6 is NCBI's exit 2 for both versions; db.mdb.bn.mixed.6 and db.mdb.bn.aliasdup.0 are LOSAT refusals.

# Rows db.envshared.* (line DBID N2e): blastp, psiblast, tblastn, tblastx and blastn -db with the same environment (blast_app_util.cpp:206-210, 732-737): NCBI's apps but psiblast write the archive of outfmt 11 without the prefetch (blastp_app.cpp:280-285, tblastn_app.cpp:294-299, tblastx_app.cpp:197-202, blastn_app.cpp:304-309), so a PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT that NStr::StringToInt cannot convert leaves it as it is, while psiblast fetches ahead before it writes one (psiblast_app.cpp:262-266); a -db search ignores BL2SEQ_LEGACY; in the other formats the value stops LOSAT as it stops NCBI, with its exception (env parity H; tests/search_environment.rs has the -subject cases).

# Rows db.ps.it.* (line PS, PS5a): psiblast's rounds of FASTA queries (-num_iterations N) against tests/db_search/paja (and the parsed-id databases of tests/db_search/ids/), queries of tests/fasta/psiblast/ (ps5_*.faa: the step-1 queries of PS5a); the files kinds are those of PS2/PS3 (-save_each_pssm writes <row_id>.asn.<n> and .pssm.<n>); the ncbi rows are NCBI 2.17.0 `psiblast -db ... -num_threads 1`. Rows db.ps.cbs0.* and db.ps.pssm.cbs0.6: -comp_based_stats 0 in one round (PS5a). Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --only db.ps.it (db.ps.cbs0, db.ps.pssm.cbs0).

# Rows db.ps.inpssm.it.* and db.ps.inpssm.f.* (line PS, PS5b): psiblast -in_pssm with -num_iterations other than 1 and with the PSSM files (the input PSSM written before round 1; .1 of -save_each_pssm), against tests/db_search/paja, PSSMs of tests/fixtures/pssm/ and tests/fixtures/db_search/db.ps.asn.{rnd,tkrnd}.6.asn; ps5_*.asn(.gz) are hand edits of the rnd PSSM (a comment descriptor, a UTF-8 identifier, no weighted residue frequencies, an empty descr) and the first 30 columns of ps4_tk_ratios without params; the review's rows (db.ps.inpssm.title.*, molinfo.*, f.longweighted, rej.bigweighted) use ps5_rnd_title_*, ps5_rnd_molinfo and ps5_rnd_diag_{long,big}weighted, hand edits of the same rnd PSSMs. Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --only db.ps.inpssm.

# Rows db.sc4b.* (line NP, series SC, SC4b): BLASTP -matrix IDENTITY with -db: SicyWSV's 89 queries (the warning for the first batch's 16 only), mode 0, XML, the archive, a query split into chunks; with SC3, blastp-short with the short queries and -word_size 2 with SicyWSV; NCBI's errors (-matrix identity with XML, exit 3; word size 6; gap costs 11/1; psiblast's IDENTITY) and LOSAT's rejection of word size 5 and blastp-fast, on which NCBI 2.17.0 dies of SIGSEGV, except with a first query batch of queries without letters, where NCBI stops with its error (BLASTP and TBLASTN). Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --only db.sc4b.

# Rows db.sc5.* (line NP, series SC, SC5): -comp_based_stats 1 and 3 with -db: BLASTP (SicyWSV's 89 queries, BLOSUM45, PAM30, pairwise, the archive, a query split into chunks), psiblast (round 1 in that mode, two rounds: the later round runs 3 as 1 with NCBI's warning) and TBLASTN (PAM70, -db_gencode 2). The rows db.ps.pssm.cbs1.6, db.ps.it.cbs1.pk.6 and db.ps.it.cbs3.pk.6 were the refusal rows db.ps.pssm.rej.cbs1, db.ps.it.rej.cbs1 and db.ps.it.rej.cbs3 until SC5 (the same commands).

# Rows db.ps.sp.*, db.ps.inpssm.sp.*, db.ps.oldfsc.* and db.ps.inpssm.oldfsc.* (line PS, PS5c): psiblast -searchsp and the environment variable OLD_FSC, against tests/db_search/paja: no Gumbel block in any round (blast_args.cpp:303-307, blast_stat.c:921-923), the cutoffs of BLAST_Cutoffs and the e-values of BLAST_KarlinStoE_simple on each round's effective search space, so the rounds' inclusion, their number and the PSSM files follow the new e-values. Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --only db.ps.sp. (and db.ps.inpssm.sp., db.ps.oldfsc., db.ps.inpssm.oldfsc.).

# Rows db.col.* (line SW, SW8 follow-up 2): databases whose volumes have column files, searched without a database mask (-db_soft_mask, -db_hard_mask or an imported search strategy, which LOSAT refuses), for which NCBI opens no column file (tests/db_search/coldb, make_coldb.py: p5m and p4m with the seg masks of segmasker, n5m with those of dustmasker and windowmasker in two volumes, n4m with dustmasker's; dmg/CASE/ copies of p4m and n4m with a damaged column; coldb/ucol/user-column-db, NCBI's database with the user column `comedy`). The ncbi rows are NCBI 2.17.0 `-num_threads 1` on these files, the same bytes as for the files without their columns (the SW8 follow-up probe); db.col.rej.* keep LOSAT's refusal of the mask options.

# Rows db.ak.* (line RG, series D, D1a; remaining-gaps-20261112/D): alias-file keys on tests/db_search/aliaskeys (alias files over taxfilter/tfp, taxfilter/tfn and multidb/p4a): NSEQ and LENGTH as NCBI's walks, STATS_NSEQ, STATS_TOTLEN, MIN_SEQ_LENGTH, FIRST_OID and LAST_OID ranges, VDBLIST, a volume reached twice; the .err rows are NCBI's CStringException texts (exit 255, the release build's path).

# Rows db.envconv.* (env parity H): -db with a CHUNK_SIZE, OVERLAP_CHUNK_SIZE, BATCH_SIZE or PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT that NStr::StringToInt (flags 0) cannot convert: NCBI stops with its CStringException (CATCH_ALL: 'Error: ' and its report naming ncbistr.cpp in the official release's build tree, exit 255) where it reads the value: CHUNK_SIZE and OVERLAP_CHUNK_SIZE in the first batch's query splitter (local_blast.cpp:59-61, split_query_aux_priv.cpp:55-57; blastn reads CHUNK_SIZE first for its mixer), BATCH_SIZE before the formatter (blast_input_aux.cpp:86-88; blastn after PrintProlog, blastn_app.cpp:258-262; psiblast never), PRE_FETCH_SEQS_LIMIT before the first batch's report (blast_app_util.cpp:732-734; not with outfmt 11 but in psiblast); with outfmt 11 NCBI writes its error archive (env-parity-20261108/h_probe/REPORT.md).

# Rows db.ps.q1.* (line RG, series Q, Q1): psiblast with blastp's database filters (-taxids, -taxidlist, -negative_taxids, -negative_taxidlist, -seqidlist, -negative_seqidlist, -no_taxid_expansion) in its rounds on tests/db_search/taxfilter/tfp (BLASTDB=tests/db_search/taxfilter for the taxonomy file), -show_gis on tests/db_search/ids/prot_v5, -parse_deflines (the PSSM's query Seq-id of each id form, the label of the later rounds' warnings; tests/fasta/psiblast/q1_*.faa), -lcase_masking, and -in_pssm with them (tests/fixtures/pssm/q1_tfp.asn.gz: NCBI 2.17.0 psiblast -query tests/db_search/taxfilter/q.faa -db tfp -save_pssm_after_last_round -out_pssm; tests/db_search/q1_sq1: makeblastdb -parse_seqids of tests/fasta/psiblast/q1_subj_q1.faa, whose first record is lcl|Query_1). Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --only db.ps.q1.

# Rows db.ps.q1c.* (line RG, series Q, Q1c): -parse_deflines with two queries of one id and with a query whose id a reported database sequence has (tests/db_search/q1c, make_q1c_inputs.py): psiblast's batches hold one query, after each of which NCBI's formatter empties its scope (CBlastFormat::ResetScopeHistory), so NCBI searches each with its own letters and shows a database sequence with the id of another query as itself. Row db.ps.q1c.kastop.subj.6 (line WQA D10 round 4, 2026-11-20): with -subject a first query of only X stops the run (no Karlin-Altschul parameters, exit 3) before the second q1, which LOSAT refuses where NCBI reaches it.

# Rows db.ps.q2.* (line RG, series Q, Q2): psiblast with the matrices of NCBI's tables other than BLOSUM62 (BLOSUM45, BLOSUM50, BLOSUM80, BLOSUM90, PAM30, PAM70, PAM250; their default gap costs and other pairs of their tables) and BLOSUM62 with other gap costs, in all rounds of a FASTA query: the later rounds' search, statistics and positives take the matrix (outfmt 0 footers and alignments with -comp_based_stats 0, the PSSM files of each round), every -comp_based_stats mode, convergence; NCBI's errors for IDENTITY and a pair outside the table. Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --only db.ps.q2.

# Rows db.ak.*.e0* and db.ak.*.ord.* (line RG, series D, D1a-2; remaining-gaps-20261112/D/SURVEY_D1a2_C.md D, E): alias files over volumes of no OID (tests/seqdb/db/empty, aliaskeys/en) with NSEQ, LENGTH, STATS_NSEQ and STATS_TOTLEN (NCBI reads OID 0 only when the statistics' total is not positive), and the order of the errors of the alias files' values, the lists, the headers (aliaskeys/dh: multidb/p4a with a damaged header file) and the accession tables (multidb/na and nnp); the CStringException texts carry the release build's path.

# Rows db.oir.* (line RG, series D, D1a-2 part 2; remaining-gaps-20261112/D/SURVEY_D1a2_A.md): FIRST_OID and LAST_OID of 2^31 or more (NCBI's negative ints) and the iteration range of the only alias file of a -db, alone and with another database (tests/db_search/oidrange: the probe cases p4a_* over taxfilter/tfp, tfn and the database o, ten sequences of tfp under lcl|o0..o9, taxid 10116); -taxids and -seqidlist rows scan the totals over NCBI's loop of the list. The row ids end with the command's index in the probe case.

# Rows db.ps.q1b.* (line RG, series Q, Q1b): psiblast -in_pssm of a PSSM whose query Seq-id is not one local id, on tests/db_search/taxfilter/tfp (BLASTDB=tests/db_search/taxfilter): tests/fixtures/pssm/q1b_gi.asn is NCBI psiblast's (2.17.0, -parse_deflines -num_iterations 2 -save_pssm_after_last_round) of tests/fasta/psiblast/q1b_gi.faa (gi|4504347|ref|NP_000549.1|, the first 30 letters of human hemoglobin alpha) against tfp; q1b_<form>.asn are it with the query's Seq-ids (and title) changed by hand (sp, pdb, pat: patent; gr: gi then other NP_000549.1; rg: the other way round; lg: local Query_1 then gi; giim; ord: gnl|BL_ORD_ID|5). The ids are shown with or without -parse_deflines; the Seq-aligns, later PSSMs and warnings take the first. The ut rows read NCBI's unit-test PSSM tests/fixtures/pssm/pssm_freq_ratios.asn.gz (frequency ratios only, a gi and a swissprot id). Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --program psiblast --only db.ps.q1b.

# Rows db.cnt.* (line RG, series D, D1a-3 part 1; remaining-gaps-20261112/D/SURVEY_D1a3.md): alias files whose NSEQ is negative as NCBI's int or 2^31 and more, whose LENGTH is 2^63 or more (NCBI's negative Int8: negative Spouge e-values printed 0, no sort of the results) or prints with NCBI's comma digits lost (tests/db_search/dbcounts over taxfilter/tfp and tfn); the too-short test (Uint4)(Int4)(T/n); the refusals of the overflowing report sums and of XML's INT64_MIN.

# Rows db.cnt.l0*, list0, short, neg1 ungapped (line RG, series D, D1a-3 part 2; remaining-gaps-20261112/D/SURVEY_D1a3.md (a)): NCBI's statistics of each subject where the database length is 0 (alias LENGTH 0 with and without STATS_*, a list whose scan visits nothing, tblastn/tblastx short subjects skipped first) and the preliminary stage's search spaces of a negative length (tests/db_search/dbcounts).

# Rows db.ps.q3.* (line RG, series Q, Q3): psiblast's -culling_limit, -gap_trigger, -xdrop_ungap, -xdrop_gap, -xdrop_gap_final and -sum_stats false in every round of a FASTA query (tests/fasta/psiblast/tk.faa and ps5_pk.faa against tests/db_search/paja; the globin tests/db_search/taxfilter/q.faa against tfp to convergence) and with -in_pssm (tests/fixtures/pssm/ps4_tk_paja.asn.gz): the later rounds' PSSM search culls and converts the X-drops and the gap trigger with the PSSM's blocks, the redo with its own Lambda (-comp_based_stats 0 and the default), the PSSM files of each round; values past Int4 (NCBI's x86-64 conversion to INT_MIN: -gap_trigger 1e300 and -1e300, -xdrop_gap 1e9, -xdrop_gap_final 1e9); NCBI's options error of -xdrop_ungap 0. losat-rejection: a gapped X-drop whose raw score NCBI's kernels cannot size (round 1 with the matrix's Lambda, -in_pssm with the PSSM's). Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --program psiblast --only db.ps.q3.

# Rows db.ps.q3b.* (line RG, series Q, Q3b): psiblast -sum_stats true, NCBI's even-gap linking of each subject's HSPs (BLAST_LinkHsps) in every round of a FASTA query and with -in_pssm (tests/fixtures/pssm/ps4_tk_paja.asn.gz): tests/fasta/psiblast/tk.faa against tests/db_search/q3b_chains (subjects whose HSPs form linked sets: outfmt 0's Expect(n)) and tests/db_search/paja, ps5_pk.faa against paja, the globin tests/db_search/taxfilter/q.faa against tfp to convergence; composition-based statistics 0 to 3 (the preliminary stage links with small and large gaps at the sum statistics' lower hit-saving cutoff, the traceback and the redo with large gaps only), -evalue 100, -window_size 0, -searchsp, the PSSM files of each round. Freeze them alone with db_search_fixtures.py freeze --program psiblast --only db.ps.q3b.

# Rows db.t5.* (line RG item T5): database sequences without parsed Seq-ids (and, rows db.t5.*.p.*, with them) without a title, each with one taxid of tests/seqdb/taxdb/t5 (tests/db_search/t5/make_t5.py; README.md there): NCBI makes the title from the taxonomy database's name of the taxid (CDeflineGenerator: x_SetTitleFromBioSrc, x_SetTitleFromProtein), which LOSAT makes as NCBI does.

(and star., lower., ratios.std30.).
